why: Chris, 1 October 2026: "each course should get a professional looking icon - can use comfyui - vary colours per course". Shown in the glossy badge on each course card of the landing page strip (public/index.php); until a file exists the card shows a line icon (lib/home.php HomeCourseLook(), which also sets each course's two cover colours - keep the object in that colour).
style: A glossy 3D icon object, smooth shiny plastic and enamel, soft studio light, like a premium app icon. The whole object centred on a plain pure white background with space all around it. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos anywhere.
